look_notes: No enemy HP bars, no elite bar with numbers, no elite name plate in any frame (the elite Guardian at 1 HP used to show «1 / 2000»). Floating damage numbers (-54, -68, -136) stay.

All stand shots (every kill / dodge / Wendigo / Stonehoof shot) now play in the centre of Kostya's glade: the flush rune circle is right under the fight. The new arena floor grade is strong ochre/orange — whole frame reads orange; editors may want to pull saturation a little.

The combat-feel root swarm (-Encounter root-swarm) ALWAYS spawns on the entry portal stone ring with water, on every seed tried (20260829, 1, 7, 42, 1337, 20260930): hero and swarm sit on the portal and read badly. Readable swarm kills come from the Wendigo stand with its 2-crawler pack (kill-swarm-pack-*). A proper fix needs a capture code change (place the swarm on the glade centre) — not done here (no second rebuild).
The big rune stone (boss arenas only) is not reachable by any capture flag without code; the calm boss-atmosphere shot uses the rune circle of the glade centre instead.
Hero dodges in the dodge cases by WALKING out of the mark (capture bot), not by rolling.

kill-guardian-z07.quality: Good, clean single kill on the rune circle; hero on the left third. The 0.0 red flash is the Guardian's previous hit on the hero.

kill-guardian-z09.quality: Good, wider; the kill is smaller in frame.

kill-bud-z07.quality: Good; the B puddle circle + fruit volley opening is a nice bonus beat; Bud is small.

kill-stonehoof-z07.quality: Good; bull walks in from the top, dies near the top third.

kill-stonehoof-z09.quality: OK but the kill sits high and small in frame.

kill-thorncaster-z07.quality: Thorncaster is off-frame right until ~1.7 s (hero walks in); kill itself readable.

kill-thorncaster-z09.quality: Better than z07: the caster is in frame earlier.

kill-snarer-z07.quality: Snarer off-frame right until ~1.7 s; small body.

kill-splitter-z07.quality: Very good: the split reads clearly (two bark halves), three kills in one clip.

kill-wendigo-z07.quality: Very good: B cone with chevrons, then the kill and a big smoke/leaf burst.

kill-swarm-z07.quality: UNREADABLE: hero and swarm on the entry portal stone ring with water (same on every seed). Do not use.

kill-swarm-pack-z07.quality: Readable root-crawler kills on clean ground (retake of the swarm shot); crawlers are small. Trim after 5 s.

after-crowd-fight.quality: Best AFTER footage: all nine kinds, overlapping B marks with chevrons, body signs, roots, smoke. Busy but readable at 0.9.

after-crowd-tank.quality: Same crowd, hero just stands and takes it — more marks on screen at once, no kills.

after-wendigo-howl.quality: Very strong: huge B ring, then the burst.

after-wendigo-leap.quality: Good, repetitive; one leap is enough (0.6-1.8).

after-stonehoof-charge.quality: Very good lane with chevrons; the bull runs through the hero.

after-multikill-z05.quality: Retake, tighter; still on the portal ring, marginal. Use only as a 0.5 s flash if at all.

boss-calm-afterclear.quality: Calm and empty: hero idle at the left edge of the rune circle, nothing moves but ambient. Static camera, strongly orange.
boss-calm-afterclear.use: BOSS v2 atmosphere (arena centre + rune circle)

boss-calm-empty.quality: Calm, greener and more atmospheric (forest edge, bushes, trail), but it is the entry portal ring with water, not the rune circle.

boss-hero-roots.quality: Very good: roots burst out of the ground around the rooted hero.

boss-hero-swarm-z06.quality: Retake, tighter; still on the portal ring, marginal.

boss-hero-wendigo-pack.quality: Good: Wendigo + two crawlers pressing the hero; replaces 'swarm pour'.

dodge-stonehoof-z08.quality: Dodged (no hit). Camera follows the hero so the lane slides left.

dodge-snarer-z07.quality: Dodged both; take B is complete (appearance -> impact).

dodge-snarer-z09.quality: Dodged; roots erupt right behind the hero.

dodge-thorncaster-z08.quality: Line B dodged cleanly; note the direct thorn shot at 4.87 does hit. Thorncaster itself is off-frame right.

dodge-thorncaster-z10.quality: Dodged, spikes erupt along the line behind the hero.

dodge-wendigo-turn-z08.quality: The 360 sweep hits the circling hero with knockback — the 'fail' beat.

dodge-wendigo-turn-z10.quality: Same hit, wider — ring fully in frame.

dodge-wendigo-dodge-z09.quality: Leap dodges; spare beat if a Wendigo dodge-success is wanted.
